data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one clean HD / pixel-inspired 2D game FX-only animation sprite sheet PNG, 1536x1024, with exactly 12 frames arranged in 3 rows x 4 columns. Each cell is 384x341.33 approx. Entire background, including all spacing between frames/cells, must be 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta. No visible grid lines, no borders, no labels, no text, no UI, no numbers, no watermark.

Use visual references: palette/theme from dragon prince elite image only: electric cyan, deep blue, ivory white, gold royal sigils, polished aquatic energy, royal authority. Do NOT draw Jay or any character: no body, dragon head, face, eyes, claws, hands, armor, cloak, shoulder plates, weapon, creature silhouette, or full dragon. Use playing card reference: actual playing-card silhouettes with rounded corners, white faces with red/black pips/suits, ocean-blue ornate card backs, clean table-card readability. Do not make tarot cards, scrolls, paper sheets, coins, UI panels, or labels. Use layout reference only as invisible 3 rows x 4 columns equal frame slots with centering and safe padding; do not reproduce guide boxes/rectangles/marks/background.

Critical containment: In every frame, all cards and all effects stay inside the central 70 percent of each cell, leaving a large clean magenta border on all four sides. No card corner, trail, gold seal, cyan suction line, spark, or glow touches any cell edge. Cards smaller and close to center; broad feeling from layered rotation/depth, not edge-to-edge scale. Same approximate scale and centered identity in every frame.

Subject: FX-only asset named “Royal Table Seizure” for Jay J, Dragon Prince elite enemy card-collection attack. This is a macro elite collect-all-cards effect, NOT a body attack, NOT dragonfire, NOT projectile. Cards are dominant subject. Multiple table playing cards are seized by a gold-and-cyan royal decree circle, lifted, pulled into spiral, compressed into bright collection seal, then vanish. Gold law-circle geometry and cyan-blue suction trails support movement. Mood calm, inevitable, ceremonial, unfairly powerful.

Style: polished clean HD sprite with pixel-inspired crisp edges, high contrast aquatic blue/cyan/white/gold palette, readable playing-card silhouettes, sharp motion arcs, smooth glow, no painterly scene, no realistic smoke, no background elements.

Frame order left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
1. Wide table-field omen: 6 visible playing cards arranged in a loose ring around center, faint gold royal decree circle underneath, small cyan spark at center.
2. Cards wake up: every card gains cyan outline and tiny gold corner sparks; cards remain readable and separate inside safe center.
3. Lift phase: cards rise and tilt toward center, thin blue suction lines connect them to central seal.
4. Command phase: larger gold law circle opens behind cards, card backs and faces start rotating inward.
5. Pull phase: cards from outer ring sweep inward along curved cyan trails, still at least 5 visible cards.
6. Strong suction: cards accelerate into spiral vortex, motion trails stretch behind each card, gold card-shaped light shards appear.
7. Peak collection: many cards orbit rapidly around a bright blue-white center inside a large gold royal seal, strongest frame, safely inside cell.
8. Compression: cards stack and fold into center as if being taken into Jay’s pile, cyan vortex and gold rings squeeze tight.
9. Capture snap: card mass collapses into white-blue flash, several card silhouettes still visible at edge of seal.
10. Aftershock: cards gone; only broad gold seal, cyan spiral residue, and small card-shaped light fragments remain.
11. Residual claim: fading royal sigil, a few blue motes and gold card fragments drift inward, empty table feeling.
12. Loop-ready fade: faint central cyan star and thin gold decree circle, no cards left, ready to disappear.

Ensure exactly one sprite sheet image, no extra panels beyond 12 frames, magenta #FF00FF background only outside the FX.
